title: Python to Machine Learning
seo_title: Python Programming for Beginners to Machine Learning | Raydex Learn
seo_description: Learn Python programming from the basics, then use pandas, charts and scikit-learn in practical projects. Free beginner-friendly lessons with code you can run in your browser.
image_alt: Python code and machine learning course cover
summary: Learn Python from variables and loops through data projects, charts and machine learning. Focus on writing code and understanding program logic, with practical projects from the start.
objectives: Write and debug Python programs with variables, loops and functions
Analyse real datasets with NumPy and pandas
Build charts and visualisations with matplotlib
Train and evaluate machine learning models with scikit-learn
Package what you learn into a small working web app
prerequisites: None. The course starts from variables and loops and builds up step by step.

title: Web Development
